messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 5xx responses on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Current error rate ~18% over 5m, mostly 502/503 and some model-runtime 5xx (segfaults/oom). Paging @alex oncall. Example trace ids: trace=abc123, trace=def456

alex: Seen. I'm oncall and will take this. Adding folks: @rachel (runtime), @dan (sre infra). Starting live mitigation coordination.

rachel: I'm model-runtime. Noted increased segfaults from runner pods. I'll pull core dumps and recent kernel logs.

dan: listing pods with recent restarts/ooms now:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep runner
runner-9f4c  2/2  Running  3  2h  node-12
runner-b7d2 0/2  CrashLoopBackOff  5  10m node-15
runner-a11c 1/2  Running  1  30m node-21
```
Also pulled last 200 lines from runner-b7d2:
```
[2026-03-17T00:11:42Z] segfault at 0 ip 0x7f... stack: 0x400 ...
2026-03-17T00:11:42Z] signal 11 (SIGSEGV) in lml_kernel.so
```

alex: Thanks. Immediate action: start routing heavy customers to fallback model variant (v1.2-fallback) and enable rate-limiting / circuit-breaker for suspect nodes. @dan can you flip routing & add a short denylist for node-15?

dan: On it. Routing rule applied via edge: add header X-Model-Fallback for 20% traffic and drain node-15 from new requests. Command used:
```
edgectl route update --path /v1/generate --policy "fallback:20%" --deny-node node-15
```
Applied. Will monitor metrics.

gina: CS: Notifying customers with elevated error counts. Working list: AcmeApp, NoteSpace, FinFlow. Sending initial advisory now (no PII).

cs-bot: Customer advisory dispatched to AcmeApp, NoteSpace, FinFlow. Ticket IDs: CS-4321, CS-4322, CS-4323.

rachel: Quick diagnostic: the segfaults correlate with large batch sequences (>2048 tokens) on quantized attention kernel. Temporary mitigation: disable KV cache on affected runners and fallback to non-quant kernel for long sequences. Commands I will run now.

rachel: Patching rollout (hotpatch) to reduce memory pressure on attention kernel, targeting 3 pods first for canary:
```
kubectl patch deployment model-runner -n inference --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runner","env":[{"name":"ATTN_KERNEL_MODE","value":"safe"},{"name":"KV_CACHE_ENABLED","value":"false"}]}]}}}}'
```
Starting canary on runner-b7d2, runner-a11c, runner-9f4c.

michael: Observability note: alerting dashboard shows RPS steady, errors drop on rerouted traffic. Will keep an eye on latency regressions.

dan: Early numbers 2m after changes: global 5xx down from 18% -> 4.5%. Node-15 still has crash loops but it's drained.

alex: Good. Keep canary for 10 minutes then ramp if stable. @rachel please capture core dumps from node-15 for postmortem and upload to artifacts.

rachel: Captured cores and kernel logs, uploading to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/3490011122/cores.tar.gz. Brief snippet of backtrace attached:
```
#0  0x00007f... in quant_attention::compute
#1  0x00007f... in runner::forward
#2  0x0000555... in main
```

irene: Creating incident runbook and linking artifacts. Runbook: INC-3490011122, assigned to rachel/dan/alex for root cause. Adding a follow-up postmortem meeting later today.

gina: CS update: customers acknowledged mitigation, some reported transient degraded throughput but no data loss. They'll accept scheduled maintenance for patching.

alex: After 12m canary ramp, metrics look stable. Increasing fallback to 60% while we finish rolling patch across the fleet. Will leave circuit-breakers in place for nodes with >3 restarts/hr.

dan: Confirmed: error rate steady ~3.8% and dropping to baseline on fully patched pods. No new crashes in last 6 minutes on canary nodes.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager closed by alex at 00:26 UTC. Final snapshot: peak error 18%, mitigated to ~3.5% after routing + hotpatch.

alex: Closing active pager; leaving monitoring on for 2h. Postmortem owners: rachel (technical), dan (infra), gina (customer comms). Schedule follow-up 2pm PT. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

rachel: Will open PR for a more defensive quant-kernel mode and add tests for long-sequence batches.

irene: Runbook and timeline archived at https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-3490011122.

alex: Marking incident as mitigated. Postmortem & action items will include: improved canary for kernel flags, KV cache heuristics, and automated node draining on crash loops.
